# OFTerm

> OFTerm (Open Fn Terminal) is an open-source, iTerm2-style terminal for fnOS
> (飞牛 NAS). It provides tabs, split panes, inline images (imgcat/imgls),
> classic color presets, and a bilingual Chinese/English UI, backed by a single
> Go static binary and an xterm.js frontend.

## Links

- Homepage: https://melchior-voidwolf.github.io/ofterm/
- Source code: https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm
- Releases: https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/releases
- Issue tracker: https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/issues

- Utilities (imgcat/imgls): https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/blob/main/docs/UTILITIES.md
- Privacy: https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md
- Security: https://github.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md

## Facts

- License: GPL-2.0 (free and open source).
- Platforms: fnOS x86_64 and arm64 packages; browser UI for Safari 15+,
  Chrome/Edge 100+, and Firefox 100+.
- Backend: a single static Go binary; no runtime interpreter, no session daemon,
  no external CDN.
- Frontend: xterm.js with WebGL rendering and DOM fallback.
- Inline images: OSC 1337 and Sixel; native Rust `imgcat`/`imgls` decode PNG,
  JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF (x86_64/aarch64), BMP, TIFF, ICO, PNM, TGA, DDS, HDR,
  QOI, and EXR in-process.
- Privacy: no telemetry, no third-party analytics, no CDN dependencies; fnOS
  owns access control; SSH hosts and credentials are never stored by the app.
- Install: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/melchior-voidwolf/ofterm/main/fnpack.json
  as a custom app source in the fnOS App Center, or download the `.fpk` from
  GitHub Releases.

## FAQ

- Is OFTerm free? Yes, it is GPL-2.0 open source.
- Which architectures? fnOS x86_64 and arm64.
- Does it collect data? No telemetry or analytics; access control belongs to fnOS.
- How do I install it? Use the custom app source above or download the fpk from
  GitHub Releases.
